bio_en: Levon Kalantarian was born on 13 March 1879 in Zakatala near Nukhi and moved with his family to Baku in 1891, studying at the Mesropian school whose teachers included Stepan Ter-Mkrtchian, Kristapor's nephew. When the Armenian schools were closed in 1895 he went to work, and from 1898 organised workers in Bibi-Eybat and made bombs and grenades cast at the Javanshirian foundry. In 1904, with Nikol Duman's recommendation, he went to Kars and on 4 July 1904 joined Tuman's 64-man band crossing via Tamrut into the homeland. He was called one of 'the last Mohicans of the old generation'.
